events.name: Bash
events.head: Check fix is on origin and inspect probe harness
events.input: $ git fetch -q origin && git merge-base --is-ancestor 62dff8d origin/main && echo ON_ORIGIN; git log --oneline origin/main -3; git rev-list --count origin/main..main; head -40 app/scripts/probe-s1-auto.mjs | grep -nE "PORT|wrangler|sim|persist" | head

events.text: The fix is already on origin/main. Now I'll re-run the probe on a fresh stack to produce evidence in this run.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe header for harness setup
events.input: $ sed -n 1,26p app/scripts/probe-s1-auto.mjs; git diff --stat 62dff8d origin/main -- cloud/src/jobs-s1.ts cloud/src/index.ts app/scripts/probe-s1-auto.mjs | tail -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find admin enter flow and harness setup
events.input: $ grep -nE "admin/enter|ADMIN_TOKEN|ADMIN_KEY" cloud/src/index.ts | head -8; ls cloud/.dev.vars* 2>/dev/null; grep -nE "SIM_PORT|vendor-sim|admin/enter" app/scripts/run-chain.sh | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect probe sign-in and server enter handler
events.input: $ grep -nE "enter|cookie|Set-Cookie" app/scripts/probe-s1-auto.mjs | head -12; sed -n 1036,1062p cloud/src/index.ts; sed -n 40,80p app/scripts/run-chain.sh

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate simulator and env var names only
events.input: $ ls cloud/scripts | grep -i sim; cut -d= -f1 cloud/.dev.vars; grep -nE "SIM_PORT|SIM_STATE|argv" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -5; grep -nE "\[vars\]|SIM|_BASE" cloud/wrangler.toml | head -10

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how centre points at simulator
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && ls wrangler* ; grep -nE "8792|SIM_URL|VENDOR" wrangler.jsonc src/*.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check wrangler config for SIM_URL and D1
events.input: $ grep -nE "SIM_URL|\"env\"|\"dev\"|migrations_dir|database_name" wrangler.jsonc | head; ls migrations | tail -2

events.text: Starting a fresh simulator and local centre on new ports to re-run the probe.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start fresh simulator and local centre with fresh D1
events.input: $ T=/tmp/t258run && rm -rf $T && mkdir -p $T && (SIM_PORT=8912 SIM_STATE=$T/sim.json nohup python3 scripts/vendor-sim.py > $T/sim.log 2>&1 & echo $! > $T/sim.pid) && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply revops-centre --local --persist-to $T/d1 2>&1 | tail -2 && (nohup npx wrangler dev --local --port 8913 --persist-to $T/d1 --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8912 > $T/dev.log 2>&1 & echo $! > $T/dev.pid); sleep 12; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "centre %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8913/admin/enter; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "sim %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8912/__state

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-s1-auto against fresh stack
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app && K=$(grep ^ADMIN_KEY= ../cloud/.dev.vars | cut -d= -f2-) && SIM_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8912 node scripts/probe-s1-auto.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:8913/admin/enter?k=$K" > /tmp/t258run/probe.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; grep -c ^PASS /tmp/t258run/probe.log; grep ^FAIL /tmp/t258run/probe.log | head; grep -iE "drive client|sim_ gcp|hidden" /tmp/t258run/probe.log | head -4; tail -2 /tmp/t258run/probe.log

events.text: Probe passes 56 of 56. Stopping the servers, then running typechecks and checking that the live Worker matches main.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Stop servers, typecheck, check deployed version
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && kill $(cat /tmp/t258run/sim.pid) $(cat /tmp/t258run/dev.pid) 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:8913 | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:8912 | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; (cd app && npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | grep -c "error TS"); (cd cloud && npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | grep -c "error TS"); git log --oneline -1 origin/main -- cloud/; git log --format='%h %ci' -1 62dff8d; cd cloud && npx wrangler deployments list --name revops-centre 2>/dev/null | grep -E "Created|Version" | tail -4

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check live Worker carries the T-258 fix
events.input: $ npx wrangler deployments list --name revops-centre 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "message|tag" | tail -3; for p in /admin/admin.js /admin-ui/admin.js /admin/assets/admin.js; do printf "%s " $p; curl -s "https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev$p?v=$RANDOM" | grep -c gcp_client_id; done; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "gcp/start %{http_code}\n" -X POST https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/api/gcp/start; git grep -n gcp_client_id origin/main -- admin-ui/admin.js | head -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find admin asset path; check publish hold
events.input: $ grep -nE "admin-ui|admin\.js" wrangler.jsonc src/index.ts | head -5; grep -n "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find admin.js URL
events.input: $ grep -rn "admin.js" admin-ui/*.html src/*.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Fetch live admin.js and check for fix
events.input: $ curl -s -o /tmp/t258run/live-admin.js -w "%{http_code} %{size_download}\n" "https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/admin.js?v=$RANDOM"; grep -c "its own External client" /tmp/t258run/live-admin.js

events.text: Live assets are auth-gated, so I can't confirm the later deploy includes the fix. I'll redeploy origin/main from a clean worktree, which is the approved step.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Deploy revops-centre from clean origin/main worktree
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && W=/tmp/t258-deploy && rm -rf $W && git worktree add -q --detach $W origin/main && cd $W/cloud && git log --oneline -1 && npm ci --silent >/dev/null 2>&1; npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | grep -c "error TS"; npx wrangler deploy 2>&1 | grep -E "Version ID|Uploaded|error" | head -4

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run deploy and show tail of output
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t258-deploy/cloud && npx wrangler deploy > /tmp/t258run/deploy.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; grep -vE "^\s*$" /tmp/t258run/deploy.log | tail -6

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how cloud public assets are built
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t258-deploy/cloud && grep -nE "\"(build|deploy|predeploy)[^\"]*\"" package.json; grep -n "public" wrangler.jsonc | head -3; ls scripts | grep -iE "build|deploy"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read build script header
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t258-deploy/cloud && head -30 scripts/build.sh | grep -vE "^\s*$"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Install deps and build centre assets in clean worktree
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t258-deploy/app && npm ci --silent >/dev/null 2>&1; echo ci=$?; cd ../cloud && bash scripts/build.sh https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev > /tmp/t258run/build.log 2>&1; echo build=$?; tail -3 /tmp/t258run/build.log; ls public | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find build error cause
events.input: $ grep -nE "Error|error|panic" /tmp/t258run/build.log | head -8

events.text: The build failed on a path problem (/tmp is a symlink). I'm checking which worktree past deploys used.

events.name: Bash
events.head: List existing deploy worktrees
events.input: $ git worktree list | grep -iE "deploy|clean" | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Rebuild in a real-path worktree under home
events.input: $ git worktree remove --force /private/tmp/t258-deploy && W=/Users/adithyamurali/.t258-deploy-wt && git worktree add -q --detach $W origin/main && cd $W/app && npm ci --silent >/dev/null 2>&1 && cd ../cloud && npm ci --silent >/dev/null 2>&1 && bash scripts/build.sh https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev > /tmp/t258run/build.log 2>&1; echo build=$?; grep -nE "Error" /tmp/t258run/build.log | head -3; ls $W/cloud/public | head -4
